name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) was launched in May 2016 by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas to provide free LPG connections to women from poor households. The objective is to promote clean cooking fuel such as LPG among rural and deprived families traditionally relying on firewood, coal or cow-dung cakes. Under Ujjwala 2.0, the scheme was expanded with an additional allocation of 1.6 crore LPG connections, including a special facility for migrant households.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: Government cash assistance of ₹1,600 for a 14.2 kg LPG connection.
Government cash assistance of ₹1,150 for a 5 kg LPG connection.
Security deposit of cylinder is covered: ₹1,250 for a 14.2 kg cylinder or ₹800 for a 5 kg cylinder.
Pressure regulator cost of ₹150 is covered.
LPG hose cost of ₹100 is covered.
Domestic Gas Consumer Card cost of ₹25 is covered.
Inspection, installation and demonstration charges of ₹75 are covered.
First LPG refill is provided free of cost.
Stove or hotplate is provided free of cost.
Deposit-free LPG connection is provided to eligible PMUY beneficiaries.

rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant's household must not have any existing LPG connection.
PMUY 2.0 eligibility is specified for women applicants.

Applicant woman must belong to at least one eligible category: SC household, ST household, PMAY-G household, Most Backward Class, Antyodaya Anna Yojana household, Tea or Ex-Tea Garden tribe, Forest Dweller, person residing on an island or river island, SECC household (AHL TIN), or poor household as per the 14-point declaration.

documents.description: KYC form as per PMUY requirements.
Ration Card issued by the State from which the application is being made.
Other State Government document certifying family composition, if applicable.
Self-Declaration as per Annexure I for migrant applicants.
Aadhaar of the woman beneficiary. Can serve as both identity and address proof when the connection is required at the same address.
Aadhaar of adult family members appearing in the family-composition document.
Proof of address. Aadhaar can serve as both identity and address proof when the connection is required at the same address.
Bank account number or bank account details of the applicant.
IFSC code of the applicant's bank branch.

tutorial_steps.title: Obtain the application forms
tutorial_steps.description: Download the forms from the official PMUY website or obtain them from the nearest LPG distributor.

tutorial_steps.title: Review KYC Form
tutorial_steps.description: Review the KYC Form available at https://www.pmuy.gov.in/documents/Supplementary%20KYC.pdf.

tutorial_steps.title: Review Supplementary KYC Document and Undertaking
tutorial_steps.description: Review the Supplementary KYC Document and Undertaking available at https://www.pmuy.gov.in/documents/Supplementary%20KYC.pdf.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete Annexure I for migrant applicants
tutorial_steps.description: For migrant applicants, use Annexure I available at https://www.pmuy.gov.in/documents/Annexure%20I.pdf.

tutorial_steps.title: Review Annexure II
tutorial_steps.description: Annexure II relates to the mechanics or pre-installation check, available at https://www.pmuy.gov.in/documents/Annexure%20II.pdf.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill out the application form
tutorial_steps.description: Fill out the application form with the required personal details.

tutorial_steps.title: Provide bank account information
tutorial_steps.description: Provide bank account information including account number and IFSC.

tutorial_steps.title: Submit the application
tutorial_steps.description: Submit the completed application and documents to the nearest LPG distributor.
